en_title: Reddit User Cuts Steam Machine Faceplates Out of Same Marble Michelangelo Used
subtitle: 石材也能上机
opus_summary: GinoWT用米开朗基罗同款卡拉拉大理石为Steam Machine制作面板，厚5至6毫米，日常运行未见散热问题，另外展示两种石材版本，并筹备小批量销售。

paragraphs.en: When I first saw the Steam Machine at Valve's office back in October 2025, the company told me that it'd release the files to 3D print new faceplates for the mini gaming PC . And while there have been plenty of 3D-printed faceplates out there, a stonemason has cut a Steam Machine faceplate from the same marble Michelangelo used.
paragraphs.cn: 2025年10月，我在Valve办公室首次见到Steam Machine时，该公司告诉我，他们会公开相关文件，让人们为这台迷你游戏PC打印新的面板。虽然网上已经出现了不少3D打印面板，但如今一名石匠用米开朗基罗使用过的同款大理石，切割出了一块Steam Machine面板。

paragraphs.en: I spotted these faceplates on Reddit, where user /u/GinoWT showed off three faceplates they made from different stones. The first of these was Statuario from Carrara, which is "the same quarry basin Michelangelo worked from," according to the thread. They made faceplates from Sahara Noir (with a beautiful gold stripe going across it) and Roman Travertine as well.
paragraphs.cn: 我在Reddit上发现了这些面板。用户/u/GinoWT展示了三块由不同石材制成的面板。其中第一块采用来自卡拉拉的Statuario大理石，据帖子介绍，这种石材来自「米开朗基罗曾经取材的同一片采石区」。他们还用Sahara Noir（中间横贯着一道漂亮的金色纹路）和罗马石灰华制作了面板。

paragraphs.en: Each slab is 5–6mm thick and bonded onto a 3D printed faceplate. That's super thin, but according to the post, that's to keep the weight down and prevent cracking. The result looks incredible. The Statuario one especially pops, contrasting really nicely off the black chassis of the mini PC.
paragraphs.cn: 每块石板厚5至6毫米，并粘合在3D打印面板上。厚度虽然非常薄，但帖子称，这样既能减轻重量，也能防止开裂。成品看起来非常惊艳。尤其是Statuario那块，与迷你PC的黑色机箱形成了十分漂亮的对比，格外醒目。

paragraphs.en: If you really want to get your hands on one of these faceplates for your own Steam Machine, you can. It looks like /u/GinoWT is preparing a small batch to sell. They've thrown together a website where you can enter your name and email, and they'll send along the pricing and shipping info whenever the marble plates are ready.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你真的想为自己的Steam Machine弄到一块这样的面板，你确实可以做到。看起来，/u/GinoWT正准备制作一小批面板出售。他们搭了个网站，你可以在那里填写姓名和电子邮箱；等大理石面板准备好后，他们会发来定价和配送信息。

paragraphs.en: The biggest question I' have about these faceplates is whether or not they negatively impact Steam Machine temperatures and performance. I did reach out to /u/GinoWT to ask if they've tested thermal performance, and they told me they've been running the Steam Machine daily with the faceplate attached and haven't noticed any problems. They also said they'd be running a stress test with the stock faceplate against the marble one to see if there's a difference. If that happens, I'll update this article with that information.
paragraphs.cn: 这些面板是否会对Steam Machine的温度和性能造成负面影响，是我最大的疑问。我确实联系了/u/GinoWT，询问他们是否测试过散热表现。对方告诉我，他们每天都在安装着面板的情况下运行Steam Machine，尚未发现任何问题。他们还表示，会用原装面板和大理石面板进行压力测试，看看两者是否存在差异。如果测试真的进行，我会用相关信息更新本文。

paragraphs.en: Even though the Steam Machine was quite a bit more expensive than Valve was planning , I love all the cool things I've seen people doing with it. As more units make their way into the wild as reservations are filled , I can only imagine the incredible things people are going to do with it.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管Steam Machine的价格比Valve原本计划的高出不少，我还是很喜欢看到人们用它做出的各种酷东西。随着预订陆续完成、更多设备开始流入市场，我只能想象人们还会用它做出多么惊人的东西。
